description:
"Etch an incomprehensible rune on your enemy's mind, paralyzing them in fear after a |cffffff1|r second delay, stunning them for |cffffff4|r seconds. This terror applies Minor Vulnerability for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r%.

If used against a monster, the paralyze lasts for |cffffff8|r seconds.

This ability cannot be dodged."
